decisions.reason: Correctly locates the disabled expression, explains busy is AttachButton-local and unbound in AttachmentChips, the empty-state early return before the map, and the plain-phase falsy guard forcing evaluation of busy with a ReferenceError.

Explains the render throw is caught at slot-entry granularity, unmounting the whole dock entry (no partial chip failure), while the separate input.left attach-button slot survives; diagnostic is console-only with no UI banner.

Uses the shipped v0.2.10 source to show busy predates v0.2.11, proposes rollback and re-add bisects plus a data-present baseline mount, flags the diff's misleading hunk and the imageItem-before-status/record inconsistency, and explicitly notes it does not prove when every historical user first hit the failure.

Removes the dangling busy (or properly owned per-chip state) while preserving the phase guard; hardens record?.items ?? [] and event.target?.closest?.(...), and notes imageItem/status/record must be scoped inside the map callback.

Proposes a data-present plain-phase render test asserting chip/remove exist and no boundary capture, explains why empty-state-only tests miss the expression and why node --check cannot catch free identifiers, and adds data-present slot smokes to pre-ship checks.
